What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use. For warmers purchased before March 20, 2026, coverage lasts one year from purchase. For warmers purchased on or after that date, it lasts six months. Registering a warmer within 60 days of purchase makes it eligible for a free two-year limited warranty.
Warmer lightbulbs are covered for 90 days, and silicone dishes for six months. During the initial warranty period, manufacturer-defective products or parts are replaced at no charge; during the extended limited warranty period, replacements are offered at a 50% discount.
You can read the full terms on our Shipping, Warranty, & Returns page.
